summary: Sprint 6.2.16 static verification: FyersController decorator now registers dual path prefixes ['brokers/fyers','api/brokers/fyers'], matching the ICICI reference pattern. Backend build is clean, Nest startup logs map all four expected routes, and both no-regression harnesses (account isolation, reconnect) print 'RESULT: ALL PASS'. No other broker controller was modified.

verification_evidence.build: pnpm --filter @cts/api build -> exit 0 (prisma generate + nest build clean)
verification_evidence.harness_account_isolation: RESULT: ALL PASS (20+ assertions incl. per-account App ID isolation, no crossover across switches, no-cred error paths, unknown-account error)
verification_evidence.harness_reconnect: RESULT: ALL PASS (S2..S10 scenarios incl. token/userId/userName/heartbeat refresh, all failure redirects, heartbeat-throw path)
verification_evidence.note_on_boot: App does not boot past PrismaModule (no DATABASE_URL in pod) — expected per user note; route mapping logs are emitted before that failure, which is sufficient for this static verification.

critical_code_review_comments: Decorator change is minimal and surgical (single line), mirroring the ICICI pattern exactly — good consistency.

Consider standardizing Zerodha and Shoonya controllers to the same dual-prefix pattern in a future sprint so all broker callbacks work regardless of whether the ingress strips /api or not (out of scope for this sprint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fyers controller now serves both /brokers/fyers/* and /api/brokers/fyers/* verbatim (global prefix is empty). If future sprints re-introduce setGlobalPrefix('api'), the dual-array decorator will produce duplicate /api/api/... routes — revisit then.
